title: Origin Swap
description: Allows you to swap your origin when you kill another player
body:
This is an addon to the Origins: Legacy and Origins: Legacy Classes mod. It allows you to swap your origin when you kill another player. You only get one swap per origin and class

Use /swap then followed by either origin or class after you've killed that player, or dont, they just get added to the list of possible targets you can swap with.
